text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's fall, and both Agnes Digital and King
Halo
have started gearing up for the
Mile
Championship. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! King Halo has finished
seventh! She had us on our toes for a
second, but it appears she's still got a
long ways to go before she's back in top
shape!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, wheeze... Ngh! Why is this happening...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, King...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still on her road to recovery. After
the
audience leaves the racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hey, King...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Digital? You came to watch me?
Thanks, but
please just leave me be.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...But I can't really say that to you,
can I?
Very
well, I grant you the right to join
me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
O-okay. So, ummm... About the race
today...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You might not have won, but you were
still
amazing. I'm just awestruck by your
ability—it hits
me every time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Your last spurt down the final stretch,
the
elegance in your running form, and
the beautiful
way you handle the turns...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All I could think was,
"This is first-rate!
King is the
most first-rate of all
first-rates!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And so... Well...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is that the only reason you thought I was

first-rate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uh, no! Nonononono! There's more! Like your flowing hair! And the loud, proud way you laugh! And your stylish signature racewear. And that caboose—ooh, whoopsie.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That's quite a list... Still, all of those things are trivial.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There's something far more important
when it
comes to being first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
At any rate. You've come all the way
here, so why
don't you have a run with
me around the track?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A serious run, of course. No one else is
around, so
we can really let ourselves
go.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: S-sure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two get permission to use the track
and begin
their private scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, wheeze... Hoo...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: King...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo loses the scrimmage without much
fanfare. Already exhausted from
today's race, she
doesn't push herself
beyond her limit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehehehe... Pathetic, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What do you think now, Digital? Was I
beautiful
and elegant like before, or am
I just a tired,
worn-out Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How can I be first-rate when there's not
a
modicum of first-rate left in me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Um... Th-that's...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Here I am, effortlessly outstripped by
even a
classic-year runner. I'm just a
weak and tired
loser.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But even if I'm but a mere shadow of my
past
self...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dusk quietly creeps in.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There's still tomorrow, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll lose again... but there's yet
another
tomorrow to come.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What if I choose to simply not give up?
What if I
choose to keep running and
keep losing until I
win? What then?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look at me, Digital. Tell me the truth. Is
there
really anything first-rate left about
me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Th-there...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There is! You still have it! You're as
unwavering as
the light of the Flying
Dutchman!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Flying what? ...What are you talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about your unflagging
tenacity. How
you never sink, no matter
how many licks you
take.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's true. No one can take away my
persistence.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how many times I lose,
or how
many times I'm laughed at or
ridiculed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I've told everyone that I'm first-rate.
That's why, even if I fall and eat dust
more than anyone else,
I've always
changed myself and stood back up.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far I fall,
I will never give
up hope!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is what makes me first-rate—now
and
forever!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... King!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when she's beaten and battered,
King Halo's
beauty doesn't fade.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do you get it, Digital? Do you understand what makes me me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I hear you, King. I've taken your
words to
heart.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Have you? Then, do you understand
what it
means for Umamusume to run?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes... We can't feel inferior.
There's no time
for that when we run!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. Whether you've gotten a
late start
or stumbled to the ground,
there's nothing you
can't recover from!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's why I will recover my form before the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Feeling bad for me... Or holding back
when you
run against me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Those things are an insult to me as a
first-rate
Umamusume. And to your own
abilities as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right... That's right... I...
had it all wrong.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You've taught me a fragment of what it
means to
be first-rate... and I'll hold it
close to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to train for the Mile
Championship!
I'll make you proud!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I know that I shouldn't be fangirling
super hard when I'm supposed to be in
serious training mode,
but... I've gotta
say it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You are every bit as divine as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital brings her hands together
as if to
offer a prayer. It's a gesture that
seems a bit silly... yet it communicates
her unwavering respect.
